title: Refund Settlement Card for Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Refund Settlement Card

The settings below apply to refunds on reservations in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, and they are identical on all eight cancellation policies (Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term).

| Setting | Value on every policy |
|---|---|
| Where refunds are sent | original payment method |
| Business days within which the card issuer posts a refund after it is issued | 10 (a guest-facing expectation only) |
| Share of every collected component refunded to the guest when the host cancels | 100.00% |

## Notes on the card

- The posting time of 10 business days is the expectation given to the guest about when the card issuer shows a refund; it is not a condition on issuing the refund.
- A host cancellation refunds 100.00% of each component collected on the stay, on every policy from Flexible to Long-Term.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical Strict stay has collected 1,200.00 of nightly price, 90.00 of cleaning fee, 183.18 of guest service fee and 207.27 of occupancy tax when the host cancels. At 100.00%, each of those amounts is returned in full to the guest's original payment method, a total of 1,680.45.
